NIELIT Launches Cybersecurity and AI Hackathon 'Cyber Kushti 2026'

The National Institute of Electronics and Information Technology (NIELIT) has launched 'Cyber Kushti 2026', a cybersecurity and artificial intelligence hackathon. The event aims to foster innovation and skill development in these critical technology areas. Further details on the hackathon's objectives and participation were not specified in the coverage.
